databuddy.description: Databuddy web and product analytics: traffic, pages, referrers, funnels, goals, errors, Web Vitals, session replays, and investigations that show why a metric moved. Can also manage goals, funnels, annotations, feature flags and short links, with a preview before every change. Sign in with your Databuddy account when the server asks (OAuth). Docs: https://www.databuddy.cc/docs/api/mcp
